name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: A menu that opens from a button. It combines the popover and menu components.

attributes.name: popovertarget
attributes.description: Native attribute that opens the popover with the given id. No JavaScript needed.

attributes.name: popover
attributes.description: Native attribute that turns the element into a popover. Closes on outside click and Escape.

notes: The popover is anchored to its trigger with CSS anchor positioning. Pick a placement with the popover--* modifiers documented on the popover page.
